result.instructions: Tools for Groq, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which models can my Groq account use right now?"; "Answer this question with llama-3.3-70b-versatile and keep the reply under 100 tokens."; "List my batch jobs and show the status of the most recent one.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Groq data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run groq_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run groq_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run groq_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. groq_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: groq_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the models available to this Groq account, with their ids, owners, context window and status. Use the id in groq_create_chat_completion. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/models.

tools.name: groq_list_batches
tools.title: List batches
tools.description: List the batch jobs of this organization, with status and request counts. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/batches.

tools.name: groq_get_batch
tools.title: Get a batch
tools.description: Get one batch job by id: status, endpoint, input and output file ids, and timestamps. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/batches/{batch_id}.

batch_id.description: The batch id, for example batch_01jh... (from groq_list_batches).

tools.name: groq_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List the files uploaded to this organization (batch inputs and batch outputs). Groq API: GET /openai/v1/files.

tools.name: groq_get_file
tools.title: Get a file
tools.description: Get the metadata of one file by id: name, purpose, size and creation time. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/files/{file_id}.

file_id.description: The file id, for example file_01jh... (from groq_list_files).

tools.name: groq_get_file_content
tools.title: Get file content
tools.description: Read the text of one file, for example a batch output in JSONL. Returns at most 200000 characters and says when it cut the text. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/files/{file_id}/content.

tools.name: groq_create_chat_completion
tools.title: Create a chat completion
tools.description: Run one chat completion on a Groq model and return the reply with token usage. This call is billed to the Groq account (tokens). Non-streaming only. Groq API: POST /openai/v1/chat/completions.

model.description: Model id from groq_list_models, for example llama-3.3-70b-versatile.

content.description: Message text (the tool result text when role is tool).

tool_call_id.description: The id of the tool call this message answers (role tool only).

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.

tools.name: groq_create_batch
tools.title: Create a batch
tools.description: Start a batch job from a JSONL input file already uploaded with purpose 'batch'. The job runs asynchronously and is billed to the Groq account. Groq API: POST /openai/v1/batches.

input_file_id.description: The id of the uploaded JSONL input file (from groq_list_files).

endpoint.description: The endpoint every request in the file calls.

completion_window.description: Time window for processing; Groq accepts 24h.

tools.name: groq_cancel_batch
tools.title: Cancel a batch
tools.description: Cancel a batch job that has not finished. Requests already completed stay in the output file. Groq API: POST /openai/v1/batches/{batch_id}/cancel.

batch_id.description: The batch id to cancel (from groq_list_batches).

tools.name: groq_delete_file
tools.title: Delete a file
tools.description: Delete one uploaded file permanently. A batch that still needs this input file can fail. Groq API: DELETE /openai/v1/files/{file_id}.

file_id.description: The file id to delete (from groq_list_files).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Groq
prompts.description: What you can do with Groq here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: pick_a_model_and_run_a_chat_completion
prompts.title: Pick a model and run a chat completion
prompts.description: List the models the account can use, with their ids. Run one chat completion on a chosen model. The call is billed to the Groq account.

prompts.name: check_the_status_of_a_batch_job
prompts.title: Check the status of a batch job
prompts.description: List the batch jobs of the organization with their status and request counts. Read one job to see its input and output files.

prompts.name: summarize_the_failed_requests_of_a_finished_batch
prompts.title: Summarize the failed requests of a finished batch
prompts.description: Read the metadata of a batch output file. Then read its text, which is cut at 200,000 characters, and sum up the failed requests.

prompts.name: start_a_batch_job_from_an_uploaded_file
prompts.title: Start a batch job from an uploaded file
prompts.description: Start a batch job from a JSONL input file that was uploaded with purpose batch. The job runs asynchronously and is billed to the account.

prompts.name: cancel_a_batch_job_or_delete_an_old_file
prompts.title: Cancel a batch job or delete an old file
prompts.description: Cancel a batch job that has not finished. Delete an uploaded file permanently, which can make a batch that still needs it fail.
